title: 'A file another MettleUp member can open' is sent with no way to open it by tapping
what: Share a routine or folder says it sends 'a file another MettleUp member can open'. The file goes out bare. When the other member taps it in WhatsApp or Files, MettleUp is not offered, because the app only accepts shared spreadsheet and CSV files. Nothing in the message or the file says where to open it. The only way in is Workout, Find a plan, Import a routine file, which the other member has no reason to know.
expected: Tapping the file offers MettleUp and opens the import, or the share adds one line telling the other member where to open it (Find a plan, Import a routine file).
who: members who get a shared routine
fix_line: Let the app take shared routine files, or add a how-to-open line to the share

title: Workout sounds says 'a bell when rest is over', but the rest-over sound is the MettleUp chime unless you pick Bell
what: The Workout sounds switch says 'A bell when rest is over, a chime for a new record'. The very next row, Rest-over sound, has 'MettleUp chime' as the default and 'Bell' as a separate choice. So a member who never changed it hears a chime, not a bell, and the word chime is used for both the rest sound and the record sound.
expected: The switch says 'A sound when rest is over' (or names the chosen sound), so it matches the Rest-over sound row.
who: members in Settings, rest timer and sounds
how_often: every time the page is read
fix_line: Change the switch caption to say 'a sound when rest is over'

title: Workout photos are called private and 'stay on this phone', but every backup file carries them
what: The photo row and the Add a photo sheet say 'Private. They stay on this phone.' Every backup file the member saves includes all workout photos, with no switch to leave them out (the photo switch in Backup covers progress photos only). Once the member saves that file to Drive or sends it somewhere, the photos have left the phone. They are rightly kept out of the copy on MettleUp's server.
expected: The words say what is true, for example 'Private. Not sent to MettleUp or your gym; included in backup files you save.'
who: members who add workout photos and save backups
fix_line: Reword the photo privacy line to mention backup files

title: On a narrow phone the Swap list can cut off 'harder version' or 'easier version'
what: Each Swap choice shows a one-line reason under the name, like 'Front shoulders · bodyweight · harder version'. The line is held to one line and cut with dots. On a 320 to 360 px wide phone the longest reasons run past the space beside the icon, so the part that matters most, harder or easier version, is the part that gets cut. Worked out from the code, not seen on a phone.
expected: The reason can wrap to a second line, or the harder or easier word comes first so it is never the part cut off.
who: members swapping an exercise on small phones
fix_line: Let the swap reason wrap to two lines

items.reason: About 300 on-screen strings pulled from the 49 files; the promise-bearing ones were read. Words say MettleUp (ForgeAI only in code comments). 'Find a plan' next to 'explore ready programs' and 'Your plan' repeats the plan/program/folder naming already filed. RPE, superset, isolation and compound are each explained where they appear. These screens are English only, so no Hinglish labels or Hindi read-aloud list apply. No banned-word list was given, so none was checked.

Easy weeks 'kept out of your records' is true (records skip easy-week workouts). The weekly goal shows 'This week: 2 of 4 workouts' on the Up next routine card. 'A routine of the same name there is updated, not doubled' matches the link import's add-only save.

No legal page, consent or sign-in screen in this area. Privacy lines: workout photos (filed) and 'Your body weight stays private' (the phone never sends body weight to the gym; the level line shows only the level). No staff or database login here.

Taps land on the thing named: See these workouts opens that range or that one workout, badges open the shelf, Find a plan opens plans, Open routines returns to Workout, the trainer row opens the YouTube link. A shared routine file lands nowhere when tapped (filed).

Greyed buttons say why: 'Tick a routine' is the button's own label, the goal steppers sit beside Off or 7, a locked 'How you log it' row has its reason line, the timer greys once the set is ticked, the share button greys while the picture is prepared. Silent failures already filed (strength comparison choice, save stuck after the limit pop-up).
English only. Segmented choices and the rest clock shrink to fit; detail rows wrap to two lines; tab and mini-bar titles are short fixed words. The Swap reason is one line with no shrink (filed).
No app icon, notification icon, badge art or manifest image is pointed at from these files. Pictures here are the member's own photos, the gym's logo on a share picture, and drawn line icons.
No old-brand picture in this area.
The one tap handler knows /workout, /shop (gym part), /shop/inbox, /shop/ask, the open-workout route, and any other plain in-app path a notification names.

Routes posted by the phone, the HQ push worker and the database (/workout, /shop, /shop/inbox, /shop/ask, /shop/message, /shop/orders, /shop/diet, /measures, /settings/feedback) are all plain paths the handler opens, and each has a page in apps/mobile/src/app.
No save button in these files is greyed out because nothing changed; the exercise form's Save lives in the library screen, outside this area.
No words in this area promise that every look or change is recorded.
No such promise here, so no missing database record to find.
